headers.//: The local-only promise, enforced by the browser rather than only claimed. connect-src is deliberately absent of any host: there is no API, no analytics and no CDN, so a dependency that started phoning home would be blocked rather than quietly succeed. blob: and data: are the app's own generated content - an uploaded screenshot's object URL, a canvas export, an imported GLB. worker-src covers the blob workers three.js spawns for KTX2/Draco. The script-src hash is index.html's pre-paint theme script, which has to be inline to beat the first paint - scripts/verify-csp.mjs recomputes it and fails if it drifts. scripts/verify-offline.mjs checks the same property from the other side.
